name: Maximum Mortgage Calculator
meta_title: Maximum Mortgage Calculator: How Much Can I Borrow?
meta_description: Find the largest mortgage loan your income supports. Uses your debts, interest rate, housing costs and front-end and back-end debt-to-income limits.
subtitle: Find the largest mortgage loan your income can support. It works out the most you can put toward principal and interest each month under debt-to-income limits, then turns that into a loan amount.
